summary: NXT Energy Solutions Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Certificate of Amendment, a routine corporate housekeeping document with no stated material transaction, special-purpose event, or binding agreement. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of a governing document amendment. Therefore, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
